question: Within a genuine accuracy tie given sampling variability, can the Agent choose a more reliable recipe by treating each connected example group equally? This changes portfolio selection, not base-model fitting or per-example voting.
population: Use only the six measured classifiers available on every original training fold. Generate every single, equal pair and equal triple. Use their frozen class-aligned probabilities. Do not load new regrouped-sensitivity predictions or school designated labels. Prefer the declared row-level accuracy for eligibility. Member order and exact ties use executable configuration content.
roles: For each of the five held partitions, hash each connected title group with prefix 'group portfolio reliability v1/' modulo three. Rotate learning, confirmation and evaluation without fitting any rule across base folds. Each of the 8301 training rows is evaluated once outside both selection and confirmation for its own base-model fold.
control: On learning rows choose the best single as common anchor and best of all recipes by row accuracy. Break ties by fewer members then smaller Brier loss then executable key. In a disjoint confirmation promote the nominee when it strictly improves row accuracy over the anchor, otherwise retain the anchor.
intervention: Measure cluster-robust paired standard error of each recipe's accuracy difference from the row leader. Among recipes at most one error unit below it, choose the largest mean of per-group accuracies, breaking ties by fewer members, higher declared accuracy, smaller Brier loss then executable key. On the disjoint confirmation promote only if it strictly beats the same anchor in the declared accuracy and does not regress in the equal-group average. On distinct evaluation compare the two selected recipes using actual row accuracy. Also document choices and group sizes.
promotion: Pooled net gain over the control must reach 0.3 percentage points, be strictly positive on at least three folds, and no fold may lose more than 0.3 percentage points before proposing a deployment experiment. Fifteen paired selection occasions and zero new encoder/classifier fits and model APIs. No final test, designated validation, or H2.
